_about: Background music library (user-supplied, 2026-11-16). Pick one track per episode: set "music": {"track": "<file>"} in videos/<slug>/audio/events.json and run scripts/audio/music.py (bgm.py fits it). 'loops' = measured by bgm.py: phrase-based tracks loop seamlessly at any Short length; through-composed ones only at some lengths, otherwise bgm.py falls back to a 2 s end fade. Moods are not listened to: titles and measurements only. Licence of each track: confirm with the user before publishing (see assets/CREDITS.md).

in_this_world(default).mp3.use_for: default for the "In this world..." fiction pillar (user, 2026-11-16); episode 2
